NSCameraUsageDescription: Master Metabolic uses your camera to take progress photos and meal snapshots that help you track your wellness journey.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Master Metabolic accesses your photo library so you can upload progress photos and meal images to track your wellness journey.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Master Metabolic saves photos to your library so you can keep a copy of your progress and meal snapshots.
